column1: Freddie Freeman stands out as the top pick with a steady track record and a strong platoon advantage against Ryan Gusto, making him a reliable option to record a hit. Shohei Ohtani also benefits from the same favorable matchup and lineup spot, offering nearly identical consistency. Randy Arozarena and Julio Rodriguez both enjoy a park boost and soft matchup, but Freeman’s blend of reliability and context puts him ahead for Beat The Streak selections.
